scope: Exploratory defensive simulation in the archived 50-node, n=4, m=2 system
old_six_edges: Observed by the detector and healthy in this experiment
fixture: Fixed exogenous additive packet errors in coded coordinates, declared before simulation, independent of physical state, watermark, plant dynamics and detector. Units are synthetic.

fixtures.burst: First six samples in each consecutive ten-sample block of [50,110) are perturbed

seeding: Deterministic child streams for each model. Separate streams for threshold calibration, healthy holdout and each fixture. Watermark candidates share physical trajectories, radial draws, initial angles and transition quantiles within each fixture.
primary_loss: Node 26 missing block squared Euclidean error, averaged over [50,110)
comparison: Paired descriptive 95% intervals conditional on recorded calibration; no parameter choice or tuning
